task_instance: Find and rank the best open-weight coding model that fits on a 16GB unified-memory MacBook, by querying HF's official benchmark leaderboards (api/datasets?filter=benchmark:official, per-dataset /leaderboard endpoint) and enriching with model size/license via api/models/<id>, then producing the comparison table the skill specifies.
blocker_detail: All outbound HTTPS requests to huggingface.co are rejected by the environment's egress proxy at the CONNECT stage (curl exit 56 / 'connect_rejected', proxy status endpoint logs repeated entries: {"kind":"connect_rejected","detail":"gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)","host":"huggingface.co:443"}). This happened for every attempted call (datasets list, leaderboard, model info), so none of the skill's core steps (Step 2 fetch benchmark datasets, Step 3 fetch leaderboards, Step 4 enrich model metadata) could be executed at all -- the domain itself is blocked by organization policy, independent of authentication (no HF token was present or needed to observe the block).
evidence: Command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://huggingface.co/api/datasets?filter=benchmark:official&limit=5" -> exit code 56, output '000', proxy error: 'huggingface.co:443 — connect_rejected (the egress proxy denied the CONNECT (organization policy) or could not reach the destination)'. Confirmed via `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:40557/__agentproxy/status` which lists multiple recentRelayFailures entries for host 'huggingface.co:443' with detail 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'. No workaround was attempted per safety rules (no credential search, no alternate network path).
